strings.dialogue.impact.spawn_door_open: With a deep grinding of stone, the doors swing open. The pressure plates sink into the floor and lock in place.
strings.interact.door.unlocked: The lock turns and the door opens.
strings.interact.door.sealed: It won't budge. Something nearby must open it.

strings.inventory.quests.empty: No quests yet. Talk to people around Haven.
strings.quest.finns_commission.title: Old Metalwork
strings.quest.finns_commission.summary: Master Finn wants some old metalwork from a shrine past the stones in Whisperwood. Nobody goes past the stones - so take Kira.
strings.quest.finns_commission.find_kira: Find Kira at the training grounds
strings.quest.finns_commission.meet_finn: Meet Finn at the village gate
strings.quest.wolf_at_the_edge.title: A Wolf at the Edge
strings.quest.wolf_at_the_edge.summary: Thomas wants proof you can look after yourselves. A starving thornwolf has been prowling the north edge of the village, near the Whisperwood gate.
strings.quest.wolf_at_the_edge.hunt_wolf: Deal with the thornwolf at the north edge of the village
strings.quest.wolf_at_the_edge.report_thomas: Tell Thomas the wolf is dealt with
strings.quest.the_old_shrine.title: The Old Shrine
strings.quest.the_old_shrine.summary: Follow Finn's map through Whisperwood to the ruins the traders spoke of, and find out what lies inside.
strings.quest.the_old_shrine.heart: Reach the heart of the shrine
strings.quest.memories_in_stone.title: Memories in Stone
strings.quest.memories_in_stone.summary: Something awoke in you at the crystal. The deeper halls hold memories of a world that has been forgotten.
strings.quest.memories_in_stone.murals: Study the murals in the Memory Hall
strings.quest.memories_in_stone.archive: Use the Memory Viewer in the Deep Archive
strings.quest.homecoming.title: Homecoming
strings.quest.homecoming.summary: Return to Haven with what you have learned. Finn will want to hear everything.
strings.quest.stubborn_well.title: The Stubborn Well
strings.quest.stubborn_well.summary: The village well has stopped flowing again, and Garrett's eyes aren't what they were.
strings.quest.stubborn_well.tell_garrett: Tell Garrett the water is flowing
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1: Hm. Hmmm. It's a horseshoe. I'll give you that. A horse might even agree.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_menu.choice3: Past the stones? Nobody goes past the stones.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_a1: Old. Older than me, which is saying something. You'll know it when you see it. It'll be the only thing down there worth carrying.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_a3: Which is why the metalwork's still there.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_task: Now. An errand. There's an old shrine past the stones in [b]Whisperwood[/b], and in it there's some old metalwork I've wanted for years. Bring it back and I'll stop pretending your horseshoes are bad.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_end: Take [b]Kira[/b]. She'll know the way, or she'll claim to, which is nearly as good. She'll be at the [b]training grounds[/b].
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_end_2: Pointy end away from you. Herbs for when it isn't.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_2: No, it's good. Better than mine were at your age. Don't tell anyone I said that - I've a reputation for grumpiness to keep up.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_hammer_2: ...Reflexes. From all the, ah, dropping. Ow. My back.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reminder: Kira's at the [b]training grounds[/b]. And see Thomas before you go anywhere near the stones - he'll want to show you which end to hold.
strings.dialogue.arc1.elena_bread: Off past the stones? Take rolls. No, more rolls. You'll come back thin, everyone does.
strings.dialogue.arc1.elena_rations: Wait! I almost forgot. Special travel rations - they'll keep you going even when regular food won't.
strings.dialogue.arc1.elena_idle: Mind the oven - and mind yourselves in those woods!
strings.dialogue.arc1.elena_evening: You're back! Come by the gathering later - the whole village is sharing supper tonight.
strings.dialogue.arc1.garrett_ask: Blasted rope's tangled again. Sixty years I've pulled this bucket and it's never once been grateful. Have a look at it, would you? My eyes aren't what they were.
strings.dialogue.arc1.garrett_reward: By the gods! You've got quite the eye, young one. Here, take this - it opens most of the storage buildings if you ever need supplies.
strings.dialogue.arc1.garrett_idle: Water flowing sweet as ever, thanks to you.
strings.dialogue.arc1.well_puzzle_fail: The rope snags. Start again from the first pull.
strings.dialogue.arc1.well_puzzle_done: The rope slips free of a loose stone, and water gushes up from below.
strings.dialogue.arc1.well_puzzle: [PH] The rope is tangled around the pulley. You'll need to work it loose, one pull at a time.
strings.dialogue.arc1.well_fixed: Clear, cold water. The rope runs smoothly now.
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_idle: Are you going on an adventure? Can I come? ...Mum says no.
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_s5: Are you really going to fight monsters?
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_s5.choice1: I hope we won't have to fight anything.
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_s5.choice2: Only if they threaten innocent people.
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_return: You're back! Did you find any treasure? Did you fight monsters?
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_return.choice1: We found something better than treasure.
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_return.choice2: We learned most monsters are just scared or hurt.
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_return.choice3: The real treasure was the friends we made along the way.
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_return_end: That's the best story ever. Tell me more tomorrow!
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_early: Dead centre! Anyway - Finn was looking for you, you know.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s3: You're going past the stones? I'm going past the stones. Finn sent word. I've been waiting all morning, which is why I'm on my third apple.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s3_a1: The [b]Big Book of Facts[/b]. A priest gave it to Dad. It's full of them.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s3_a2: I don't need to read it, I know what's in it. Dad told me.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s3_end: Dad first, though. He'll want to see us before we go anywhere near the stones. He says that a lot.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s3_end_2: Come on - his cabin's just down the path.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s3_facts: Here's what you need to know about [b]Whisperwood[/b]. Fact one: the trees can hear you, so don't insult them. Fact two: thornwolves can smell lies, which is why they always bite the liar first. Fact three: if you get lost, follow the moss. It always points to the nearest pie.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_banter_village: Dad's cabin is just down the path. He'll want to tell you about the moss.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_banter_forest: Stay close. And don't insult the trees - they can hear you. Fact.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_banter_shrine: You've been quiet since that chamber. Whatever happened in there - I'm with you.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_banter_home: Has the village always been like this? Everyone sharing, helping each other... it's just like those murals.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_stay_menu: Want me to hold position here?
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_early: Kira's off at the training grounds, if you're looking for her.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_s4: Ah, there's my favourite pair of troublemakers. Let me guess - Finn's got you heading into the deep woods again?
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_s4_menu.choice2: Kira says you know the area well.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_s4_menu.choice3: Why don't you come with us?
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_s4_a1: You always are. But 'careful' and 'safe' aren't the same thing in those woods.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_s4_a2: Used to. These old joints don't handle the underbrush like they used to.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_s4_a3: I wish I could! But my knees creak louder than rusty hinges. I'd only slow you young ones down.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_s4_end: Something's been stirring up the wildlife lately - animals acting more aggressive than natural.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_s4_end_2: If you're both set on this, you'd better know how to defend yourselves. Come with me to the training grounds - we'll start with the basics.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_lesson_done: Not bad for a first go. Now listen, because this next bit matters.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_lesson_done_2: There's a thornwolf been skulking about the north edge of the village, out by the Whisperwood gate. Starving, by the look of it - and the hungry ones don't back off.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_lesson_done_5: Meet me at the north gate. I'll show you how to deal with it.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_wolf_wait: That wolf's still out by the [b]north gate[/b]. Brace the bite, then hit back. Off you go.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_wolf_back: Back already? Good. You did well out there.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_wolf_back_2: He braced, just like you said. I'd have shot it, but you made me stand there.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_wolf_back_3: I'm impressed. Truly. But a wolf's one thing - out there you'll meet things that think.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_wolf_back_4: So, one last test. The both of you, against me. Don't hold back - I won't.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_test_again: Back for another go? Good. Same as before - the both of you, against me.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_after: Not bad! You two might actually survive out there. Now, about equipment...
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_after_2: Nothing shiny. Shiny's for people who want to be looked at.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_after_kira: Oh, she's lovely. Plain wood and everything. Thanks, Dad.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_after_2_2: One more thing... If you get in real trouble, blow this. It won't bring help, but it might scare off whatever's chasing you.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_after_2_3: Go and see Finn before you leave. He was heading for the [b]village gate[/b].
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_idle: Keep your guard up and your feet moving. And bring my daughter home in one piece.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_violent: Kira told me about the guardian. I taught you to defend yourself, not to choose violence first.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_map_2: These paths go places I've never seen. How do you know them?
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_map_3: I'm old. Old people know paths. It's most of what we're for.
strings.dialogue.arc1.wisperwood_door: Brambles choke the old trail into Whisperwood.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_away: Follow the map. And come home safe - both of you.
strings.dialogue.arc1.claw_marks: Wait. See that? Scratch marks - fresh, and deep. Dad says the wolves have been getting bolder. Fact. Probably.
strings.dialogue.arc1.blue_lights: Those lights... they're not fireflies. Fireflies don't hum. ...I'm not drawing that in the book until I know what it is.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_stones: It's always like this past the stones. Dad says the trees out here are just sulking.
strings.dialogue.arc1.claw_marks_spotted: Wait - over there. Look at that tree.
strings.dialogue.arc1.big_book_menu: Hold still. I'm getting this down while it's fresh.
strings.dialogue.arc1.big_book_a1: Adding a fact. Wolves bite first. Block, then bonk. That's the wolf. That's you blocking. That's the bonk.
strings.dialogue.arc1.big_book_a2: I can draw. Drawing's better. Writing's just drawing for people with no imagination.
strings.dialogue.arc1.big_book_2: That's the first one in here that I found out myself. All the others are Dad's, from the priest.
strings.dialogue.arc1.big_book_b1: It's a great fact. It's probably the best one in the book.
strings.dialogue.arc1.stone_pillars_2: Look. Nobody's kneeling. Nobody's carrying a whip. They just look... normal. The priest said that without lords watching, people starve. These ones don't look starved.
strings.dialogue.arc1.stone_pillars_3: Huh. Maybe the priest never came this far either.
strings.dialogue.arc1.tablet_1: "In the beginning, all stood as one, / United beneath the equal sun..."
strings.dialogue.arc1.tablet_2: "From unity comes the strength to grow, / Triangle's peak shall higher go..."
strings.dialogue.arc1.tablet_3: "Upon this base, four corners strong, / Square foundations shall last long..."
strings.dialogue.arc1.tablet_4: "Precious gem of varied face, / Diamond holds each person's place..."
strings.dialogue.arc1.tablet_5: "Above all else, hope's light shall shine, / Star eternal, truth divine..."
strings.dialogue.arc1.shrine_pedestals: [PH] Five stone pedestals ring the vine-covered door: Circle, Triangle, Square, Diamond and Star. The tablets around the courtyard might tell you the order.
strings.dialogue.arc1.shrine_entry_kira: By the gods... it's massive. And old. Older than anything I've ever seen.
strings.dialogue.arc1.shrine_entry_kira_2: The poem was telling a story about how communities grow and thrive. It's nothing like the priests' stories about divine mandate.
strings.dialogue.arc1.shifting_floor: [PH] This passage looks like- ...That was close. The floor almost split us up! Let's stick together.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_split_3: I'm fine! I'm fine. I've got two rolls and a strong will. Meet you in the middle!
strings.dialogue.arc1.split_wall: Solid stone. No answer from the other side.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_reunion_2: There you are! You look weird. Glowy weird.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_reunion_menu.choice1: There's a voice in my head.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_reunion_a1: Oh, that's normal in shrines. Fact.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_reunion_a2: The long way round. That wall went back up as soon as I got off the plate. ...I ate one of the rolls. For strength.
strings.dialogue.arc1.heart_3: Oh! Oh, that's... hello. You're warm. Are you warm? I think you're warm. I don't actually know what warm is.
strings.dialogue.arc1.heart_a1: I was hoping you'd know. I've got... a long table. People laughing. Someone passing bread. That's all of me there is.
strings.dialogue.arc1.heart_a2: Fair, completely fair, but I don't think I can. I'll be quiet. ...What did you have for breakfast?
strings.dialogue.arc1.heart_4: There's another piece of... something, nearby. Like a word on the tip of a tongue. If I had a tongue. Can we go and get it? Call me the Guide. That sounds helpful.
strings.dialogue.arc1.heart_sight: [b]Soul Sight[/b] - press [input=SoulSight] to see hidden doors and mechanisms. In a fight, it shows what your foes mean to do.
strings.dialogue.arc1.heart_5: Oh, and I think I can help you move. Like a step, but... slippier. Try it next time something big swings at you.
strings.dialogue.arc1.heart_step: [b]New move: Soul Step[/b] - a quick step in any direction that nothing can hit for a moment.
strings.dialogue.arc1.hidden_door: Oh - sorry. Sorry! I didn't mean to stare.
strings.dialogue.arc1.hidden_door_2: You were doing a very good job of being a wall. Honestly. Very convincing.
strings.dialogue.arc1.memory_door: It's stuck. There's something about this floor, though... Try looking at it the other way. The soul way. [input=SoulSight]
strings.dialogue.arc1.shrine_crystal_glow: A great crystal hums at the heart of the chamber. Its light feels strangely familiar.
strings.dialogue.arc1.shrine_crystal_dim: The crystal is quiet now, its light gone into you.
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_s13: You look... different. There's something in your eyes. What happened in there?
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_s13_menu.choice1: Tell her about the soul fragment.
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_s13_menu.choice2: Keep it to yourself for now.
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_told: A divine spirit? But the priests say the gods only speak through official channels...
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_secret: Well, whatever happened, I'm glad you're safe.
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_paint: Look at these paintings! These people had no kings, no nobles. How did they organize anything?
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_paint_menu.choice2: They seem to have managed just fine.
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_paint_menu.choice3: What if the stories we've been told are wrong?
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_wrong: That's a dangerous thought. But looking at this place... maybe dangerous thoughts are what we need.
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_end: Whatever this place is, it's not finished with us yet.
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_again: Leaders chosen by merit, and rotated... schools for everyone... I keep reading them over.
strings.dialogue.arc1.central_mural_find_3: Yes... I remember more. There were six others. They feared what we represented. They feared people would see there was another way.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_dormant: Three great stone guardians stand motionless before the throne.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_rest: The three wardens stand still, their long watch finally over.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_s14_2: [PH] All three of them! Aim for the joints - that's how father taught me to hunt large game!
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_s16: [PH] The light... I remember the light...
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_s16_2: Bearer of the Light... why do you carry the Master's essence? I was meant to guard this place from those who would exploit its knowledge. But you...
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_s16_menu.choice1: I want to restore what was lost.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_s16_menu.choice2: I seek to understand the truth.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_s16_menu.choice3: I carry the soul of the one you served.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_s16_menu.choice4: [Strike it down while it is weak]
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_p1: Restoration... yes. The Master spoke of this possibility before the end came.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_p2: Truth. The rarest treasure of all. The six who came before sought only power.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_p3: Master... even in fragments, your light shines true.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_peace: I have failed in my duty. Much of the knowledge I was meant to protect has been lost. But not all.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_peace_2: Take these. They contain not just power, but memory. Memory of how things could be.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_violent_2: We... we could have talked to it. I heard it trying to speak near the end. Why did we have to...?
strings.dialogue.arc1.viewer_s17_3: Now you understand. The histories were rewritten. The truth was buried. But fragments remain, waiting for those brave enough to seek them.
strings.dialogue.arc1.viewer_s17_4: Everything we were taught... the kingdoms, the gods we worship... they destroyed something beautiful.
strings.dialogue.arc1.wounded_wolf: [PH] A Thornwolf lies in the undergrowth, whimpering. With your new sight you can see the corruption burning through it - it isn't vicious. It's in pain.
strings.dialogue.arc1.wolf_heal_2: You can heal them? That's incredible! No wonder they were acting strange - they were suffering!
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_spar: You found it. And something else found you, I think.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_spar_2: Pick up that sword. Properly. Let's see what Thomas taught you.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_spar_again: Again. Sword up. Hit, then block - you know this.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_spar_after: Not bad. Not bad at all.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_spar_after_2: I made this a long time ago. I dabbled in fighting when I was young. Silly dreams. Every boy has them.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_spar_after_3: You caught my arrow with tongs.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_spar_after_5: It's warm. Is it meant to be warm?
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal: Welcome back. I can see from your eyes that you found more than metal fragments.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_2: I suppose it's time for truth. [color=#7fb6ff]I've been waiting seventy years for someone like you to appear.[/color]
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_menu.choice1: Seventy years? You're not that old.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_menu.choice2: You've been waiting for me specifically?
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_r1: Ah, you caught that, did you? Sharp eyes... or perhaps something more than eyes now.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_r2: Not you personally, but someone like you. Someone who could carry the burden.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_r3: I see you're learning to read between the lines. Good.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_rev_b: What I said wasn't entirely false, just... incomplete. What happened to you in that shrine was no accident. Use those abilities wisely - not everyone appreciates having their words examined.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_menu2.choice1: You're one of them, aren't you? A follower of Equalitas.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_menu2.choice2: How long have you known what I would find?
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_menu2.choice3: The whole village knows, don't they?
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_q1: The last, I believe. Though I pray there are others, hidden in distant places.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_q2: I knew when I first saw you. There was something familiar about your spirit - something that reminded me of the old days.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_q3: Some suspect. Most simply live the old ways without knowing why. Haven is... special. We've preserved what we could, even if we couldn't preserve the memory of why.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_rev_c: The village... the way we share everything... this isn't normal, is it? Other places aren't like this.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_rev_c_2: Your generation was raised in our ways without knowing their origin. Natural kindness, unforced by doctrine.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_rev_c_3: [PH] This hammer was forged in the last days of the war. It can shape metal touched by divine essence. One day soon, it will strengthen your blade.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_rev_c_4: But know this - the six who rule now have agents everywhere. They watch for the old power returning. You will be hunted.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_menu3.choice1: Then we'll have to be stronger than they are.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_menu3.choice2: Maybe it's time people knew the truth.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_menu3.choice3: Are you saying I should hide this power?
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_h1: Strength isn't always about power, young one. Sometimes it's about knowing when to stand and when to move wisely.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_h2: The truth is dangerous. But lies are poison that spreads with time. Perhaps you're right.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_h3: I'm saying you should be careful. Not that you should do nothing.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_rev_d: The soul of Equalitas was shattered into seven pieces. You carry three of them now. The other four lie hidden in the domains of the six false gods.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_rev_d_2: These locations... they're in the heart of enemy territory. The Iron Theocracy, the Merchant Republic...
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_path.choice1: We have to try. People deserve to know the truth.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_path.choice2: Maybe we should gather allies first.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_path.choice3: This is bigger than I thought. I need time to think.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_p1: Brave, but dangerous. The direct path often leads to martyrdom.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_p2: Wisdom. There are others who preserve fragments of the old ways. Finding them will be crucial.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_p3: Time is a luxury, but wisdom... wisdom is a necessity.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_end: Whatever path you choose, you won't walk it alone. Rest now. Talk to Kira in the morning - she has a lot to think about too.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_done: Kira was out by the well, last I saw. Go to her.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s21: I've been thinking all night about what we saw. My whole life, I believed the priests - that some people were born to rule and others to serve. But those murals...
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s21_menu.choice2: It's hard when everything you've been taught is wrong.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s21_menu.choice3: You don't have to decide everything right now.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_21a: I believe people should be free to help each other without someone above them taking credit. I believe knowledge should be shared, not hoarded.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_21b: It is. But maybe it's also liberating? Like I can finally ask the questions I was afraid to ask before.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_21c: You're right. But I know enough to know I want to help. Whatever comes next, I'm with you.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s21_end: I want to see more of those places. And if there are people suffering under lies... well, I'm a pretty good shot. Come on - Finn's gathering everyone for supper.
strings.dialogue.arc1.farewell_violent: Some of the villagers say they can feel something dark about you since you came back. Remember who you want to be.
strings.dialogue.arc1.farewell_1: Our young friends will be leaving us soon. They go to seek truth in a world that has forgotten it.
strings.dialogue.arc1.farewell_1_2: [PH] Take these - supplies for the road, and a crystal you can use to reach me. Remember: you carry more than power. You carry hope.
strings.dialogue.arc1.farewell_menu.choice3: I'll come back when this is over.
strings.dialogue.arc1.farewell_2: You already make me proud. Now go, and show the world what's possible.
strings.dialogue.arc1.road_1: So... where do we go first?
strings.dialogue.arc1.road_choice: [PH] The world map would open here.
strings.dialogue.arc1.road_choice.choice1: The Merchant Republic - investigate economic oppression.
strings.dialogue.arc1.road_choice.choice2: The Scholar Kingdom - seek hidden knowledge.
strings.dialogue.arc1.road_choice.choice3: The Warrior Clans - face direct conflict.
strings.inventory.map.title: Map
strings.item.healing_herb.desc: A bitter leaf from Haven's herb farm. Chewed, it closes small cuts and steadies the breath.
strings.item.bread_roll.desc: Elena's soft roll, still a little warm. Good for a quick bite between fights.
strings.item.special_ration.desc: A hearty travel ration packed for the road. Fills you up for the long walk ahead.
strings.item.finns_blade.desc: A real blade stamped with an anvil and a mountain. Finn made it long ago. It's warm, and not from the forge.
strings.item.fresh_bread.desc: A crusty loaf straight from the oven.
strings.item.feast_loaf.desc: A huge festival loaf, sweet and dense. Enough to share with the whole party.
strings.item.jar_of_honey.desc: Golden honey from the village hives. A spoonful lifts tired spirits.
strings.item.dried_herbs.desc: A bundle of dried herbs. Brewed into tea, they ease aches.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reminder_thomas: Good, you found Kira. Now go and see Thomas at his cabin before you go anywhere near the stones - he'll want to show you which end to hold.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_heal_before: Here - drink this first. I'd rather you start the lesson whole.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_heal_after: Easy - you took a few knocks. Drink this.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_heal_test: That's the hardest I've been hit in years. Here - one for you, before anything else.
strings.dialogue.arc1.claw_marks_look: Wait. See that? Scratch marks - fresh, and deep. Dad says the wolves have been getting bolder. Fact. Probably.
strings.item.healing_potion.desc: A red draught from Thomas's cabin. Drunk down, it closes wounds and steadies the breath.
strings.notify.rested.message: Everyone is back on their feet.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_early_walk: Oh - morning! I'm in the middle of training.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s3_walk: There you are! Give me a moment - I'm training.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_grounds: Right, here we are. Kira, you watch - this one's for your friend.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_grounds_start: Now. Feet, sword, breath. Show me.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_gate: There it is. See how it keeps to the edge? Starving. A thornwolf waits till you're close, and the moment you move, it bites. You won't beat it to the first hit, so don't try.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_gate_brace: Instead you [b]Brace[/b]. Tuck in and take the bite on your guard, then hit it while it's pulling back. Catch your breath when it backs off, never when it's on you.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_gate_move: [b]New move: Brace[/b] - it blocks hits that land while you're tucked in, best right in the middle.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_gate_kira: And I'll shoot it from the back while it's busy chewing on you. Fact.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_gate_alone: Not this time, you won't. This one's theirs - you stay with me.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_gate_noticed: Steady - it's seen you. Here it comes! Brace!
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_gate_done: Hardly a scratch on you. You braced it, just like I said! Back to the cabin, the pair of you - one last test.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_map_greet: There you are. I heard from Thomas you passed his training with ease.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_map_greet_2: Don't let it go to your head - a wolf at the edge of the village isn't the deep woods. Come on, I'll see you to the gate.
